body.mix: বিভিন্ন শব্দের সাথে ভিন্ন ভিন্ন Preposition ব্যবহৃত হয়। এর ফলে ব্যবহারগত বা অর্থগত পরিবর্তন সাধিত হয়। তাই Preposition ইংরেজিতে খুবই গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। Appropriate Preposition দুভাবে আয়ত্ত করা যায়। এক. মুখস্থ করার মাধ্যমে, দুই. অভিজ্ঞতা লাভের মাধ্যমে। Preposition-এর ব্যবহার বিশেষভাবে খেয়াল করলে যে অভিজ্ঞতা অর্জিত হয় তাতে Preposition মুখস্থ করার প্রয়োজন হয় না। এখানে বিগত পরীক্ষাসমূহে আসা Prepositions-এর একটি Index দেয়া হয়েছে যাতে এক নজরে সেগুলো আয়ত্ত করা যায়। অতঃপর Example সহ তাদের বিশদ বিবরণ দেয়া হয়েছে।
body.en: Different prepositions are used with different words. As a result, there is a change in usage or in meaning. So preposition is very important in English. Appropriate prepositions can be mastered in two ways: one, by memorising; two, by gaining experience. If you pay special attention to the use of prepositions, the experience you gain makes memorising prepositions unnecessary. Here an index of the prepositions that have come in past examinations is given, so that they can be mastered at a glance. Afterwards they are described in detail with examples.

body.mix: যেসব শব্দ Noun বা Pronoun-এর পূর্বে বসে তার সাথে বাক্যের অন্যান্য শব্দের সম্পর্ক দেখিয়ে দেয় তাদেরকে Preposition বলে। — He sat on the table. — She looked at me. সাধারণ Preposition গুলো হচ্ছে : at, above, across, against, among, after, before, beside, below, behind, beyond, between, by, down, for, from, in, into, like, near, of, on, over, outside, out, since, to, towards, through, up, upon, with, within, without. আমরা একটি Diagram-এর সাহায্যে কিছু Preposition-এর মৌলিক অর্থ জেনে নেই। [Diagram: above (উপরে), over (উপরে), on (লেগে থাকা অর্থে উপরে), to (দিকে), in (ভেতরে), out (বাইরে), through (মধ্য দিয়ে), into (গতি বোঝাতে ভেতরে), out of (বাইরে), under, below, beneath (নিচে/তলে)]
body.en: The words that sit before a noun or pronoun and show its relation with the other words of the sentence are called prepositions. — He sat on the table. — She looked at me. The common prepositions are: at, above, across, against, among, after, before, beside, below, behind, beyond, between, by, down, for, from, in, into, like, near, of, on, over, outside, out, since, to, towards, through, up, upon, with, within, without. Let us learn the basic meanings of some prepositions with the help of a diagram. [Diagram: above (above), over (above), on (above, in the sense of touching), to (towards), in (inside), out (outside), through (through the middle), into (inside, showing motion), out of (outside), under, below, beneath (below/underneath)]

body.mix: Verb-এর পর শুধু Preposition আসলে Preposition টি Adverb হিসেবে কাজ করে। কিন্তু Preposition-এর পর Noun আসলে তা Preposition হিসেবেই কাজ করে। — The sun has gone down (Adv) [সহ: পল্লী উন্নয়ন কর্মকর্তা ২০১৩] — He went down the road. (Pre) [শিক্ষা অধি: রেজি: ২০০০]
body.en: If only a preposition comes after a verb, that preposition works as an adverb. But if a noun comes after the preposition, it works as a preposition itself. — The sun has gone down (Adv) [Assistant: Rural Development Officer 2013] — He went down the road. (Pre) [Education Dept: Registration 2000]

body.mix: গঠন, কার্য এবং ব্যবহারের ভিত্তিতে Preposition-কে ছয় ভাগে ভাগ করা হয়। যথা: i. Simple Preposition ii. Double Preposition iii. Compound Preposition iv. Phrase Preposition v. Participle Preposition and vi. Disguised Preposition. i. Simple Preposition : Simple Preposition মূলত একটি word দ্বারা গঠিত হয়। যেমন: at, on, off, of প্রভৃতি। ii. Double Preposition : দুটি Simple Preposition একত্রে যুক্ত হয়ে একটি Preposition-এর মতো কাজ করলে তাকে Double Preposition বলে। যেমন Upon (up + on), within (with + in) প্রভৃতি। iii. Compound Preposition : Noun, Adjective বা Adverb-এর পূর্বে simple Preposition যুক্ত হয়ে যে Preposition গঠিত হয়, তাকে Compound Preposition বলে। যেমন—about (on + by + out), behind (by + hind) প্রভৃতি। iv. Phrase Preposition : দুই বা ততোধিক Preposition এবং অন্য word মিলে যদি একক Preposition রূপে ব্যবহৃত হয়, তাকে Phrase Preposition বলে। যেমন: by means of, in front of প্রভৃতি। v. Participle Preposition : Present Participle অথবা Past Participle, Preposition-এর মতো ব্যবহৃত হলে, তাকে Participle Preposition বলে। যেমন— Past — The man went past me. Regarding — I know nothing regarding this matter. vi. Disguised preposition : কখনো কখনো on, at, of, per prepositions-গুলোর পরিবর্তে a বা o ব্যবহৃত হয়। এ রকম a এবং o-কে Disguised Preposition বলে। যেমন— He gets up at 8 o'clock (o = of) They went a hunting (a = on)
body.en: On the basis of formation, function and use, prepositions are divided into six kinds, namely: i. Simple Preposition ii. Double Preposition iii. Compound Preposition iv. Phrase Preposition v. Participle Preposition and vi. Disguised Preposition. i. Simple Preposition: A simple preposition is mainly formed by a single word. For example: at, on, off, of etc. ii. Double Preposition: When two simple prepositions join together and work like a single preposition, it is called a double preposition. For example, Upon (up + on), within (with + in) etc. iii. Compound Preposition: The preposition formed when a simple preposition is joined before a noun, adjective or adverb is called a compound preposition. For example — about (on + by + out), behind (by + hind) etc. iv. Phrase Preposition: When two or more prepositions together with other words are used as a single preposition, it is called a phrase preposition. For example: by means of, in front of etc. v. Participle Preposition: When a present participle or past participle is used like a preposition, it is called a participle preposition. For example — Past — The man went past me. Regarding — I know nothing regarding this matter. vi. Disguised preposition: Sometimes a or o is used in place of the prepositions on, at, of, per. Such a and o are called disguised prepositions. For example — He gets up at 8 o'clock (o = of) They went a hunting (a = on)

body.mix: 1. কোনো স্থানে বা দিকে অর্থে— Go to the south. He has gone to school. 2. পর্যন্ত অর্থে— Suvo folded the pant to the knee. Wash yourself from head to feet. Life means waiting from birth to death. 3. উপনীত হওয়া বা পরিণতি অর্থে— The leader was shot to death. Burn the paper to ashes. 4. উদ্দেশ্য বা অনুসারে অর্থে— Send the book to him. He buys everything to my choice. 5. তুলনা বা অনুপাত বুঝাতে— We won the game by four goals to zero. As the cat is to the tiger, so is crocodile to the dynosaur.
body.en: 1. In the sense of to some place or direction — Go to the south. He has gone to school. 2. In the sense of up to — Suvo folded the pant to the knee. Wash yourself from head to feet. Life means waiting from birth to death. 3. In the sense of reaching or resulting in — The leader was shot to death. Burn the paper to ashes. 4. In the sense of purpose or according to — Send the book to him. He buys everything to my choice. 5. To show comparison or ratio — We won the game by four goals to zero. As the cat is to the tiger, so is crocodile to the dinosaur.

body.mix: 1. তুলনামূলকভাবে ছোট স্থান ও নির্দিষ্ট কোনো স্থিরবিন্দু বোঝাতে— He lives at Luxmibazar in Dhaka. Open at page 30. Meet me at the railway station. 2. সময় নির্দিষ্ট করে বোঝাতে— Come to the office at 7 P.M. Nazrul became famous at the age of 21. এভাবে, at dawn, at first, at noon, at night কিন্তু at day নয়। 3. মাত্রা বোঝাতে— I drive at 70 km per hour. I run at the speed of a lion. 4. মূল্য বোঝাতে— Mango sells at 50 taka per kg. I bought the shirt at Tk. 200. 5. ঝুঁকি নেয়ায় বা ভয়াবহ পরিণতিতে— He went there at the risk of his own life. Agamemnon saved the nation at the cost of his daughter. 6. চরম অবস্থা বা সীমা প্রকাশের ক্ষেত্রে— At first At last At best At worst
body.en: 1. To show a comparatively small place and a specific fixed point — He lives at Luxmibazar in Dhaka. Open at page 30. Meet me at the railway station. 2. To specify time — Come to the office at 7 P.M. Nazrul became famous at the age of 21. In this way: at dawn, at first, at noon, at night, but not at day. 3. To show rate or speed — I drive at 70 km per hour. I run at the speed of a lion. 4. To show price — Mango sells at 50 taka per kg. I bought the shirt at Tk. 200. 5. In taking a risk or in a terrible consequence — He went there at the risk of his own life. Agamemnon saved the nation at the cost of his daughter. 6. In expressing an extreme state or limit — At first, At last, At best, At worst.

body.mix: বাংলায় of-এর অর্থ মূলত 'র' বা 'এর'। of ব্যবহৃত হয় এরকম প্রায় সবক্ষেত্রেই এ অর্থ প্রকাশ করে। 1. কোনো কিছু দিয়ে তৈরি অথবা কারো দ্বারা নির্মিত, সৃষ্ট বা রচিত কোনো কিছু বোঝাতে— Give me a ring of gold. Recite from a poem of Nazrul. 2. কোনো সম্পর্ক ও গভীর সম্বন্ধ বা উৎস বোঝাতে— Ranbindranath was a man of West Bengal. Rabindranath comes of a noble family. Everybody likes the sweetmeats of Natore. 3. মালিকানা বা অধিকার বোঝাতে— He lives in the house of his uncle. This is a book of my brother. 4. কারণ বোঝাতে— He died of cholera.
body.en: In Bangla, the meaning of of is mainly 'r' or 'er' (the possessive suffixes). In almost all cases where of is used, it expresses this meaning. 1. To show something made of something, or made, created or composed by someone — Give me a ring of gold. Recite from a poem of Nazrul. 2. To show a relation, a deep connection or origin — Ranbindranath was a man of West Bengal. Rabindranath comes of a noble family. Everybody likes the sweetmeats of Natore. 3. To show ownership or right — He lives in the house of his uncle. This is a book of my brother. 4. To show cause — He died of cholera.

body.mix: 1. পরে ঘটে এরকম অর্থে— Where will you go after dinner? He will meet us after the meeting. I attended the meeting after my friends. 2. পিছু নেয়া বা ধাওয়া করা অর্থে— We ran after the snatcher. Do not hanker after money. 3. পরিকল্পনা, style বা অন্য কিছু অনুসরণ বা অনুকরণ করা অর্থে— The museum is built after my design. This pen was bought after my choice. He is named after his father. 4. ধারাবাহিকতা বোঝাতে— We entered one after another. 5. সত্ত্বেও অর্থে— After all his efforts, he failed to convince me.
body.en: 1. In the sense of happening afterwards — Where will you go after dinner? He will meet us after the meeting. I attended the meeting after my friends. 2. In the sense of following or chasing — We ran after the snatcher. Do not hanker after money. 3. In the sense of following or imitating a plan, style or something else — The museum is built after my design. This pen was bought after my choice. He is named after his father. 4. To show succession — We entered one after another. 5. In the sense of in spite of — After all his efforts, he failed to convince me.

Do not hanker after money. 3. পরিকল্পনা, style বা অন্য কিছু অনুসরণ বা অনুকরণ করা অর্থে— The museum is built after my design. This pen was bought after my choice. body.en: 1. To show on top of — Keep the box on the shelf. 2. To show date or time — Meet me on Monday. She will come to me on 10 July. 3. About something — Ruhi delivered a speech on Marxism. Write an essay on Agriculture. 4. To show dependence — We live on rice. 5. In the sense of according to — He acted on my advice. 6. Immediately after — On hearing this, she swooned. 7. By virtue of something — He was released on the ground of his ill health. 8. In the sense of working for a side — He is on the committee.

He was disqualified for mental disorder. 3. সময়ের ব্যাপ্তি বোঝাতে— He has been reading for an hour. He has been absent for three days. 4. কারো পক্ষে বোঝাতে— I will fight for him. I am speaking for him. 5. সত্ত্বেও অর্থে— For all his riches, he is unhappy.
body.en: 1. In the sense of 'for' — It is a gift for Ruhi. What can I do for you? 2. In the sense of because of — We could not go out for rain. He was disqualified for mental disorder. 3. To show a span of time — He has been reading for an hour. He has been absent for three days. 4. To show on someone's behalf — I will fight for him. I am speaking for him. 5. In the sense of in spite of — For all his riches, he is unhappy.

He sat by me yesterday. 3. পরিমাপের ক্ষেত্রে— The house is 10 feet by 15 feet. 4. কাছাকাছি সময় বোঝাতে— He will get back by Monday. He will come by 4 p. m. 5. কোনো ব্যক্তি কর্তৃক সম্পাদিত বা লিখিত বা রচিত অর্থে— The letter was written by me. This is a poem by Rabindranath Tagore. 6. অনুযায়ী বা অনুসারে— You are guilty by our law. What is the time by your watch now? 7. শপথ বোঝাতে— He swore by Allah.
body.en: 1. For travelling or going by some route — I shall go there by land/ air/ water/ boat/ launch/ bus/ train. [Exceptions: on foot, on horseback] 2. To show beside — The building is just by the bazar. He sat by me yesterday. 3. In measurement — The house is 10 feet by 15 feet. 4. To show approximate time — He will get back by Monday. He will come by 4 p.m. 5. In the sense of done, written or composed by a person — The letter was written by me. This is a poem by Rabindranath Tagore. 6. According to — You are guilty by our law. What is the time by your watch now? 7. To show an oath — He swore by Allah.

body.en: 1. In the sense of happening before some time or turn — He passed SSC examination before 1992. Your turn will come before me. 2. To show in front of — He stood before me. He fainted before me. 3. In giving greater importance — He always emphasizes hard work before brain. We want prevention before cure. 4. For consideration — He put proposal before the Chairman.

Your proposal is under consideration. 4. শাসনামল বোঝাতে— Were we in peace under Ershad? 5. অনুযায়ী বা অনুসারে অর্থে— Under the term, he would be punished if he fails to repay.
body.en: 1. To show in a low place or under something — We took rest under a banyan tree. Keep the bag under the table. 2. In the sense of working under someone or being in some condition: I am doing M. Phil under Mr. Rumi. Try to keep the naughty boys under control. 3. To show a state of being in process — He can work hard under pressure. Your proposal is under consideration. 4. To show a reign or rule — Were we in peace under Ershad? 5. In the sense of according to — Under the term, he would be punished if he fails to repay.

body.mix: Off মূলত adverb হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়। তবে adjective ও preposition হিসেবে এর ব্যাপক ব্যবহার আছে। এখানে preposition হিসেবে off-এর ব্যবহার দেখানো হয়েছে। 1. ছোঁবে নয় দূরে এ রকম বোঝাতে— Be off my sight. Take the chair off the room. 2. বিচ্ছিন্নতা, বিচ্যুত অর্থে— Take the shoes off your feet. Get the spot off your clothes. 3. অভ্যস্ততা থেকে দূরে বোঝাতে— The patient is off his meal. For some reasons, he is off his jovial mood.
body.en: Off is mainly used as an adverb. But it is also widely used as an adjective and a preposition. Here the use of off as a preposition is shown. 1. To show at a distance, not touching — Be off my sight. Take the chair off the room. 2. In the sense of separation or deviation — Take the shoes off your feet. Get the spot off your clothes. 3. To show being away from a habit — The patient is off his meal. For some reasons, he is off his jovial mood.

I do everything with my own hands. 3. সত্ত্বেও অর্থে— With all his learning, he is dishonest. 4. বস্তুবাচক বা গুণবাচক অবস্থা প্রকাশ করতে— He looked at her with fixed eyes. He works with confidence.
body.en: 1. To show with a person — She lives with her parents. I spent the vacation with my friends. 2. To show an instrument of work — Do not play with safety match. I do everything with my own hands. 3. In the sense of in spite of — With all his learning, he is dishonest. 4. To express a material or qualitative state — He looked at her with fixed eyes. He works with confidence.

body.mix: বড় স্থান বা সময়ের পূর্বে in এবং অপেক্ষাকৃত ছোট স্থান বা সময়ের পূর্বে at বসে। তবে সময়ের পূর্বে in বসলে তারপর noun-এর পূর্বে the বসে। কিন্তু সময়ের পূর্বে at বসলে তারপর the বসে না। উল্লেখ্য, morning, evening, afternoon-এর পূর্বে in এবং night, noon, dusk, dawn-এর পূর্বে at বসে। He lives at Moghbazar in Dhaka. He came to me at 7 pm in 2002.
body.en: In is used before a big place or time, and at before a comparatively small place or time. But when in is used before time, the comes before the noun after it. When at is used before time, no the comes after it. Note that in is used before morning, evening and afternoon, and at before night, noon, dusk and dawn. He lives at Moghbazar in Dhaka. He came to me at 7 pm in 2002.

body.mix: কোনো কিছুর ভেতরে কারো বা কোনো কিছুর অবস্থানের স্থিতিশীলতা বুঝাতে in এবং অবস্থানের গতিশীলতা বা রূপান্তর বোঝাতে into বসে। The students are in the classroom. The teacher walks into the classroom.
body.en: In is used to show the static state of someone or something being inside something, and into to show the movement or transformation of position. The students are in the classroom. The teacher walks into the classroom.

body.mix: দিন বা তারিখের আগে on, মাস বা বছরের আগে in এবং নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে at বসে। I joined the job at 8 am on Saturday in 2002.
body.en: On is used before a day or date, in before a month or year, and at before a specific time. I joined the job at 8 am on Saturday in 2002.
body.bn: দিন বা তারিখের আগে on, মাস বা বছরের আগে in এবং নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে at বসে। I joined the job at 8 am on Saturday in 2002.

body.mix: সাধারণত ভবিষ্যৎকালে নির্দিষ্ট ব্যাপক সময়ের শেষমুহূর্ত বোঝাতে in এবং ঐ সময়ের মধ্যে বোঝাতে within বসে। I will be back in a week. (সপ্তাহের শেষ দিকে) I will be back within a week. (সপ্তাহের মধ্যে)
body.en: Generally, in the future tense, in is used to show the end moment of a specific broad period of time, and within to show inside that period. I will be back in a week. (towards the end of the week) I will be back within a week. (within the week)
body.bn: সাধারণত ভবিষ্যৎকালে নির্দিষ্ট ব্যাপক সময়ের শেষমুহূর্ত বোঝাতে in এবং ঐ সময়ের মধ্যে বোঝাতে within বসে। I will be back in a week. (সপ্তাহের শেষ দিকে) I will be back within a week. (সপ্তাহের মধ্যে)

body.mix: ভবিষ্যৎকালে ব্যাপক সময়ের মধ্যে বোঝাতে in এবং নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে by/before ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং অতীতকালে ব্যাপক সময়ের পরে after ব্যবহৃত হয়। She will come back in a week. She will come back by 3 pm. She came back home after one month.
body.en: In the future tense, in is used to show within a broad period of time, and by/before before a specific time; in the past tense, after is used after a broad period of time. She will come back in a week. She will come back by 3 pm. She came back home after one month.
body.bn: ভবিষ্যৎকালে ব্যাপক সময়ের মধ্যে বোঝাতে in এবং নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে by/before ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং অতীতকালে ব্যাপক সময়ের পরে after ব্যবহৃত হয়। She will come back in a week. She will come back by 3 pm. She came back home after one month.

body.mix: সীমার মধ্যে অবস্থান বোঝাতে in, সীমার বাইরে অবস্থান বোঝাতে to এবং সীমার মধ্যে উপরিভাগে অবস্থান বোঝাতে on ব্যবহৃত হয়। Rangpur is in the north of Bangladesh. The Bay of Bengal is to the south of Bangladesh. Tajindong is on the south of Bangladesh.
body.en: In is used to show being situated within a boundary, to to show being situated outside a boundary, and on to show being situated on the surface within a boundary. Rangpur is in the north of Bangladesh. The Bay of Bengal is to the south of Bangladesh. Tajindong is on the south of Bangladesh.
body.bn: সীমার মধ্যে অবস্থান বোঝাতে in, সীমার বাইরে অবস্থান বোঝাতে to এবং সীমার মধ্যে উপরিভাগে অবস্থান বোঝাতে on ব্যবহৃত হয়। Rangpur is in the north of Bangladesh. The Bay of Bengal is to the south of Bangladesh. Tajindong is on the south of Bangladesh.

body.mix: নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে Since বসে এবং তা সব সময় Perfect বা Perfect Continuous Tense এ ব্যবহৃত হয়। From সব tense-এ-ই নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং For ব্যাপক সময়ের পূর্বে ব্যবহৃত হয়। It has been raining since Monday. It has been raining for a week. It did not rain from January.
body.en: Since is used before a specific time, and it is always used in the Perfect or Perfect Continuous tense. From is used before a specific time in all tenses, and For before a broad period of time. It has been raining since Monday. It has been raining for a week. It did not rain from January.
body.bn: নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে Since বসে এবং তা সব সময় Perfect বা Perfect Continuous Tense এ ব্যবহৃত হয়। From সব tense-এ-ই নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং For ব্যাপক সময়ের পূর্বে ব্যবহৃত হয়। It has been raining since Monday. It has been raining for a week. It did not rain from January.

body.mix: যে করে তার পূর্বে by বসে এবং যে যন্ত্র বা হাতিয়ার ব্যবহার করে করা হয় তার পূর্বে with বসে। The snake was killed by the boy with a stick.
body.en: By is used before the doer, and with before the instrument or weapon used to do it. The snake was killed by the boy with a stick.
body.bn: যে করে তার পূর্বে by বসে এবং যে যন্ত্র বা হাতিয়ার ব্যবহার করে করা হয় তার পূর্বে with বসে। The snake was killed by the boy with a stick.

body.mix: দুয়ের মধ্যে between এবং দুইয়ের অধিক হলে among ব্যবহৃত হয়। Divide the fruits between Rasel and Rubel/among Juhi, Jasmine and Yesmin.
body.en: Between is used for two, and among when there are more than two. Divide the fruits between Rasel and Rubel/among Juhi, Jasmine and Yesmin.
body.bn: দুয়ের মধ্যে between এবং দুইয়ের অধিক হলে among ব্যবহৃত হয়। Divide the fruits between Rasel and Rubel/among Juhi, Jasmine and Yesmin.

body.mix: পাশে অর্থে beside এবং অধিকন্তু অর্থে besides ব্যবহৃত হয়। He sits beside me. Besides the pond I like the house.
body.en: Beside is used in the sense of beside, and besides in the sense of in addition. He sits beside me. Besides the pond I like the house.
body.bn: পাশে অর্থে beside এবং অধিকন্তু অর্থে besides ব্যবহৃত হয়। He sits beside me. Besides the pond I like the house.

body.mix: তল স্পর্শ করে থাকলে on এবং তলের ওপরে থাকলে over বসে। স্পর্শহীন অবস্থায় above বসে। The ball is on my head. The shade is over my head. The sky is above us.
body.en: On is used when touching a surface, and over when above a surface. In a state without touch, above is used. The ball is on my head. The shade is over my head. The sky is above us.
body.bn: তল স্পর্শ করে থাকলে on এবং তলের ওপরে থাকলে over বসে। স্পর্শহীন অবস্থায় above বসে। The ball is on my head. The shade is over my head. The sky is above us.

body.mix: কোনো তলের নিচে থাকলে Under এবং তল স্পর্শ করে থাকলে below ব্যবহৃত হয়। Keep the basket under the table. There is a bag below the box.
body.en: Under is used when something is below a surface, and below when it touches the surface. Keep the basket under the table. There is a bag below the box.
body.bn: কোনো তলের নিচে থাকলে Under এবং তল স্পর্শ করে থাকলে below ব্যবহৃত হয়। Keep the basket under the table. There is a bag below the box.

body.mix: বাদ দিয়ে বা ব্যতিরেকে অর্থে except এবং ছাড়া বা নেই অর্থে without ব্যবহৃত হয়। I like him except his hair style. I can not do without him.
body.en: Except is used in the sense of leaving out or excluding, and without in the sense of without or not having. I like him except his hair style. I can not do without him.

body.mix: Abhorrent to (ঘৃণা) — Corruption is abhorrent to the honest. Abide by (মেনে চলা)—Competitors must abide by judge's decision. Abound in (a source) (প্রচুর পরিমাণে বিদ্যমান থাকা) — Hilsha fish abounds in the Padma. Abound with (A source with sth) (প্রচুর পরিমাণে বিদ্যমান থাকা) — The Padma abounds with hilsha fish. Absent from (অনুপস্থিত)— He was absent from the meeting. Absorbed in (নিমগ্ন)— He was absorbed in deep thought. Abstain from (sth) (বিরত থাকা)— Always try to abstain from evil company. Accede to (সম্মত হওয়া)— I acceded to his request. Acceptable to (sb) (গ্রহণযোগ্য)— His offer is acceptable to us. Access to (প্রবেশাধিকার)— There is no free access to the chairman's room. Accommodate with/to (সাহায্য করা/খাপ খাওয়ানো)— We always try to accommodate our clients with financial assistance./Her eyes took a while to accommodate to the darkness. Accompanied by (সঙ্গী হওয়া)—Depression is almost always accompanied by insomnia. Accomplished in (পারদর্শী)—He was accomplished in all the arts. Accord to, with (দেয়া, সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ হওয়া)— Every school accords high priority to the quality of teaching./The punishment accords with the current code of discipline. Accordance with (অনুসারে)—In accordance with her wishes she was burried in France. According to (অনুসারে)— According to our records you owe us $ 130. Account for (sth) (জবাবদিহি করা)— He was unable to account for the error. Account with (হিসাব)— I have a savings account with Standard Chartered Bank. Accused of (অভিযুক্ত)— The man was accused of murder. Accustomed to (অভ্যস্ত)—She quickly became accustomed to his messy ways. Acquainted with (পরিচিত)—I am not personally acquainted with the gentleman in question. Adapt to (sth) (খাপ খাওয়ানো)— He cannot adapt to new situations. Add to (যোগ করা)— She's added a picasso to her collection. Addicted to (আসক্ত)— Fifty million Americans are addicted to nicotine. Addition to (সংযোজন)— The clerk was a recent addition to the staff. Adept in (দক্ষ)—Silas proved adept in the art of avoiding potholes in the road. Adequate to (পর্যাপ্ত)—I didn't have adequate time to prepare. Adhere to (লেগে থাকা)—One should adhere to one's principles. Adjacent to (সন্নিহিত)— Our house was adjacent to the river. Admit of (অবকাশ থাকা)— Your conduct admits of no excuse. Admit to/into (স্বীকার করা/যোগ দেয়া)— The new law was generally admitted to be difficult to enforce./Spain was admitted to the European community in 1986. Advantage of/over (সুযোগ লওয়া)—The advantage of booking tickets is that you get better seats. Advantageous to (সুবিধাজনক)—The lower tax rate is particularly advantageous to poorer families. Adverse to (প্রতিকূল)— Your plan is adverse to our interest. Affection for (স্নেহ)— I felt deep affection fo the child. Affectionate to/towards (স্নেহপূর্ণ)—Jo is very affectionate to/towards her. Affinity for/with/between (তীব্র অনুরাগ, সাদৃশ্য)—She seems to have a natural affinity for/with water. Affix to (সংযুক্ত করা)— She affixed a stamp to the envelope. Absent from (absent)— He was absent from the meeting. Absorbed in (absorbed)— He was absorbed in deep thought. Abstain from (sth) (to refrain)— Always try to abstain from evil company. Accord to, with (to give, to be consistent)— Every school accords high priority to the quality of teaching./The punishment accords with the current code of discipline. Account for (sth) (to account for)— He was unable to account for the error. Account with (account)— I have a savings account with Standard Chartered Bank. Allot to (to allot)— They allotted a separate desk to everyone. Allude to (to allude)— He alluded to the story in the speech. Answerable to sb, for sth (answerable)— I am not answerable to anyone for my business. Apology to (sb) (কারো কাছে ক্ষমা চাওয়া)— You must ask apology to him. Appeal to sb/ for sth/ to do sth (আবেদন করা)— The footballer appealed to the referee for a free kick/She has lodged an appeal against the severity of the fine. Appendix to (পরিশিষ্ট)— Please look at the appendix to the main chapter. Appetite for (ক্ষুধা)— My brother has no appetite for food. Applicable to (প্রযোজ্য)—The new qualifications are applicable to all European countries. Apply for (দরখাস্ত করা)— I intend to apply for a job in the Accounts Dept. Appointed to (a post) (নিযুক্ত)— He appointed me to this post. Appointment with (sb) (সাক্ষাতের সময়) — I have an appointment with the MP at 10:30. Appropriate to (প্রযোজ্য)— Is this an appropriate occassion to discuss Finance? Approve of (অনুমোদন করা)— He doesn't approve of smoking. Apt in/at (তীক্ষ্ণ/দক্ষ)— He is apt in mathematics, or at (quick) figures. Aptitude for (আসক্তি) — I have no aptitude for music. Argue for/against (পক্ষে/বিপক্ষে বলা) — He argued against death penalty. Argue over (কোনো বিষয়ে তর্ক করা) — The children were arguing over which TV program to watch. Argue with (তর্ক করা)— I do not want to argue with you about the matter. Arrive at (পৌঁছানো)— The leader arrived at a decision at last. Ascend from (উপরে ওঠা)— He watched the mist ascending from the valley. Ascend to (আরোহণ করা)— The divers have begun to ascend to the surface of the water. Ashamed of (লজ্জিত)— I am ashamed of his conduct. Ask about (খোঁজ করা) — He asked about you. Asked for (sth) (চাওয়া)— The money we asked for was not forthcoming. Aspirant to/for (উচ্চাকাঙ্ক্ষী)—The soldier was an aspirant to the throne. Aspiration to do sth/ for sth (আকাঙ্ক্ষা)— The young girl has an aspiration for the better future. Aspire to (আকাঙ্ক্ষা করা)— As a child, he aspired to be a great writer. Assign to (নির্দিষ্ট করে দেয়া)—The case has been assigned to our senior officer. Assist in (সাহায্য করা)— The army arrived to assist in the search. Associated with (জড়িত)— I no longer wish to be associated with people like him. Assured of (আশ্বাস দেয়া)— He assured me of his help. Astonished at (বিস্মিত)—The doctors were astonished at the speed of her recovery. At lunch (দুপুরের খাবারে)— I was talking so much at lunch that my food went cold. At the bottom (নিচে)— The teacher asked the students to do exercise at the bottom of the page. At the fork (রাস্তার মোড়)— Turn right at the first fork and go 500 yards up the road. At the sight of (দর্শনে)— I was horrified at the sight of so much distress. At the weekend (সপ্তাহান্তে)— Are you doing anything special at the weekend? Attach to (জুড়ে দেয়া)— I attached a photo to my application form. Attachment for (আসক্তি)—This food processor has a special attachment for grinding coffee. Attacked by/with (আক্রমণ)— He was attacked and seriously injured by a gang or youths. Attain to (অর্জন করা)—He attained to greatness by dint of perseverance. Attend on (সেবা করা)— Nurses attend on patients. Attend to (মনোযোগ দেয়া) — Please attend to my lecture. Attended by/with (সঙ্গী হওয়া)—The princess was attended by her ladies-in-waiting. Attentive to (যত্নবান)— Ministers should be more attentive to the needs of families. Attribute to (আরোপ করা)— Most experts have attributed the drawing to Michel Angelo. Authority on (বিশেষজ্ঞ)— Mr. Swan is a leading authority on English Grammar. Authority over (কর্তৃত্ব)— The parents should have authority over their sons and daughters. Avail of (সুযোগ লওয়া)— Employees should avail themselves of the opportunity to buy cheap shares in the company. Available to/for (লভ্য)— There is no money available for an office party this year./It is vital that food is made available to the famine areas. Averse to (বিমুখ)— People who are averse to hard work generally do not succeed in life. Aversion to (বিরাগ)— She has a deep aversion to getting up in the morning. Aware of (অবহিত/সচেতন)— He was well aware of his problems.

Bar to (বাধা)— A lack of formal education is no bar to becoming rich. Based on (প্রতিষ্ঠিত)— The film is based on a short story by Thomas Mann. Beg for (কোনোকিছু চাওয়া)—They beg for mercy. Behave towards (to behave)— I think he behaved disgracefully towards you. Believe in (to believe)— They don't believe in living together before marriage. Brood over (to think over)— He sat there brooding over whether life was worth living. Burdened with (burdened)— He is burdened with a big family. Burst into/out (to burst out)— He burst into tears at the sad news./They burst out laughter at my story. Business with (sb) (business)— I am pleased to do business with you. Busy at/in/with/about (busy)—He is busy at his desk./He is busy in doing his work./He is busy with his lesson./He is always busy about nothing. Buy of (to buy)— I bought this thing of him. By heart (by heart)— He learnt the poem by heart.

body.mix: Callous to (উদাসীন)— He is callous to my sufferings. Capable of (সমর্থ)— Only the Democratic Party is capable of running the country. Care for (যত্ন নেওয়া)— He does not care for me. Careful/Careless of/about (যত্নবান/যত্নহীন)— He is in a really foul temper. So be careful about/of what you say to him./It was careless of him to leave the door unlocked. Cast aside (ছুঁড়ে ফেলা)— As soon as he become rich, he cast aside his old friends. Catch at (আঁকড়ে ধরা)— A drowning man catches at a straw. Cater for /to (সরবরাহ করা)—The club caters for children between the ages of 4 and 12. Cause of, for (কারণ, যুক্তি)— I have no cause for anxiety. Cautious of; Caution aganist (সতর্ক)—He is cautious of giving offence./Take proper caution against malaria. Certain of/Certainty of/about (নিশ্চিত/নিশ্চয়তা)— He is quite certain of the attacker's identity. There is no certainty of/about it. Certify to (প্রত্যয়ন করা/ সত্য বলে ঘোষণা)— I certify to his honesty. Change into (এক জিনিস হতে অন্য জিনিসে পরিণত করা)— The magician changed the frog into a ball. Characterised by; Characteristic of (বিশেষত্বপূর্ণ)— His plans are characterised by boldness./ Sentimentality seems a characteristic of all the writers of that period. Charge against/of (অভিযোগ)— The police brought a charge of theft against him. Charge with (অভিযুক্ত করা)— He was charged with theft. Claim upon/aganist/to/for (দাবি)— I have no claim upon or against him./She has no rightful claim to the title./Please submit your claim for travelling. Clear of (অপসারণ করা)—This is the first time in his life that he's been clear of debt. Cling to (লেগে থাকা)— The road clings to the coastline for several miles, then it turns in land. Close with (গ্রহণ করা)— The play closed with the tragic death of both hero and heroine. Clothed with/in (পরিহিত)— Clothed with shame, she left the place./She was clothed in a purple gown. Clue to (সূত্র)—We now have an important clue to the identify of the thief. Co-operate with (সহযোগিতা করা)— The spanish authorities co-operated with the British police in finding the terrorists. Coincide with (একই সময়ে ঘটা)— His statement coincides with mine. Collaborate with/in/on (সহযোগিতা করা)— Two writers collaborated on the script for the film./ A German company collaborated with a Swiss firm to develop the product./ The British and Indian police collaborated in catching the terrorist. Collide with (ধাক্কা লাগা)— It was predicted that a comet would collide with one of the planets. Combination of (সমন্বয়)— The combination of Nitrogen and Glycerin creates a potent explosive. Combine with (মিলিত হওয়া)— As a writer, he combined wit with passion. Commence on/with (আরম্ভ করা)— The course commences with a one week instruction on Art Theory. Commensurate with (যথোপযুক্ত)— He was paid a salary commensurate with skills and experience. Comment on/upon (মন্তব্য করা)—My mum always comments on/upon what I'm wearing. Commit to (মুখস্থ করা)— Commit the passage to memory. Common to (সাধারণ)—English has some features common to many languages. Communicate to/with/on (অন্যকে প্রদান করা)—We can now communicate instantly with people on the other side of the world./Has the news been communicated to the staff yet? Compare to (ভিন্ন জিনিসের মধ্যে তুলনা করা)— He compared the heart to a pump. Compare with (সমজাতীয়ের মধ্যে তুলনা করা)— Compare Akbar with Aurangazeb. Compatible with (সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ)— Drive the car at a speed compatible with safety. Compensate for (ক্ষতিপূরণ দেয়া)— He will compensate you for the loss. Compete with/for (প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বিতা করা)—Both girls compete for their fathers' attention./I am not competing with that noise. Competent for (যোগ্য)— He is competent for the post. Complain of, about (sth) (অসুস্থতার কথা জানানো, নালিশ করা)— He complained of headache. Complain to (sb)(নালিশ করা)— These days everybody complains to the government. Comply with (সম্মত হওয়া)— Mrs. Tania complied with my request. Composed of (গঠিত)—The committee is composed of MPs, doctors, academics and members of the public. Conceal from (গোপন করা)—Is there anything you are concealing from me? Conceive of (ধারণা করা)—He couldn't conceive of a time when he would have no job. Concentrate on/upon (কেন্দ্রীভূত হওয়া/মনোযোগ দেয়া)—I am going to concentrate on/upon my writing for a while. Concern about/over/for sb/sth (উদ্বেগ)— Villagers expressed concern about the level of traffic. Concerned over/at/by sth, at/over sb/sth (উদ্বিগ্ন)— Students are concerned for their result. Concerned in, with (জড়িত, সম্পর্কিত)— I am not concerned in this matter. The lesson is concerned with poetry. Conclusion of/to/from (সমাপ্তি)— I found the conclusion of the film rather irritating./This is the conclusion to the story./You can draw some conclusion from the evidence. Condemn to (দণ্ডিত করা)— The criminal was condemned to death. Condole with/on (সমবেদনা প্রকাশ করা)—We condoled with him on his loss. Conducive to (উপকারী)— Early rising is conducive to health. Confer on/with/about (পরামর্শ করা)— An honorary decorate was conferred on him by Edinburgh University./I shall confer with him about your prayer. Confess to/Confession of (স্বীকার করা)— She confessed to her husband that she had sold her wedding ring./I can't ask for help. It feels like a confession of failure. Confide in/to (বিশ্বাস করে বলা)— I've never felt able to confide in my sister./He confided to his friends that he didn't have much hope for his marriage. Confidence in (আত্মবিশ্বাস)— She has full confidence in her ability. Confident of (আশাবাদী)— He is confident of success. Confined in/to (আবদ্ধ)— Let's confine our discussion to the matter in question please./He is confined in jail. Conform to (অনুসরণ করা)— A style of reporting must confirm to the prevailing practice. Confront with (সম্মুখীন হওয়া)— Customers are confronted with a bewildering amount of choice. Confuse with (তালগোল পাকানো)—You're confusing me with my sister,— she's the one studying drama. Congenial to (উপযোগী)— The climate is congenial to health. Congratulate on (অভিনন্দন জানানো)— I congratulated him on his success. Connected or connection with (সংযুক্ত/সংযোগ)— Everyone tries to be connected with the film industry. Conscious of (সচেতন)— I was very conscious of the fact that I had to make a good impression. Consideration for (বিবেচনা)— You've got no consideration for others! Consist in (বিদ্যমান থাকা)— True happiness consists in contentment. Consist of (গঠিত)— The school consists of five classrooms. Consistent with (সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ)— We do not consider his behaviour to be consistent with the holding of a high ranking job. Consolidate for (একত্রীকরণ করা বা হওয়া)— The two companies consolidated for greater efficiency. Consult with (পরামর্শ করা)— This afternoon the Prime Minister was consulting with his advisors and we are expecting an announcement shortly. Contact with (সংযোগ)—She finally made contact with him in Italy. Contemporary of (সমসাময়িক ব্যক্তি)— C. Marlowe was a contemporary of Shakespeare. Contented with (সন্তুষ্ট)— He is contented with a little. Contiguous to (সংলগ্ন)— The two states are contiguous with/to each other, but the laws are quite different. Contrary to (বিপরীত)— She acted contrary to orders. Contrast to/between (বৈষম্য; বৈসাদৃশ্য)—Your action is a contrast to our profession./ There is a great contrast between the two. Contrast with (তুলনা)— The marble is smooth and polished, making a strong contrast with the worn stonework around it. Contribution to (অবদান)— He has a great contribution to this locality. Control over (নিয়ন্ত্রণ)— He has no control over himself. Converse with (কথা বলা)— She's so shy that conversing with her can be quite difficult. Converted to (ধর্মান্তর করা)— He converted to Catholicism when he got married. Convict of (দণ্ড দেওয়া)— He has twice been convicted of robbery. Convinced of (নিশ্চিত, আশ্বস্ত)— He is convinced of your honesty. Cope with (এঁটে ওঠা)— She cannot cope with so much work. Correspond with, about/to (চিঠিপত্র লেখা, সঙ্গতিপূর্ণ হওয়া)— I shall correspond with him about the matter./The American FBI corresponds to the British M15. Cast aside (to cast aside)— As soon as he become rich, he cast aside his old friends. Catch at (to catch hold of)— A drowning man catches at a straw. Cater for /to (to cater)—The club caters for children between the ages of 4 and 12. Cause of, for (cause, reason)— I have no cause for anxiety. Cautious of; Caution against (cautious)—He is cautious of giving offence./Take proper caution against malaria. Certain of/Certainty of/about (certain/certainty)— He is quite certain of the attacker's identity. There is no certainty of/about it. Certify to (to certify/to declare true)— I certify to his honesty. Change into (to change from one thing into another)— The magician changed the frog into a ball. Characterised by; Characteristic of (characteristic)— His plans are characterised by boldness./ Sentimentality seems a characteristic of all the writers of that period. Charge against/of (charge)— The police brought a charge of theft against him. Charge with (to charge)— He was charged with theft. Claim upon/against/to/for (claim)— I have no claim upon or against him./She has no rightful claim to the title./Please submit your claim for travelling. Clear of (to clear off)—This is the first time in his life that he's been clear of debt. Cling to (to cling to)— The road clings to the coastline for several miles, then it turns in land. Close with (to close with)— The play closed with the tragic death of both hero and heroine. Clothed with/in (clothed)— Clothed with shame, she left the place./She was clothed in a purple gown. Clue to (clue)—We now have an important clue to the identity of the thief. Co-operate with (to co-operate)— The spanish authorities co-operated with the British police in finding the terrorists. Coincide with (to happen at the same time)— His statement coincides with mine. Collaborate with/in/on (to collaborate)— Two writers collaborated on the script for the film./ A German company collaborated with a Swiss firm to develop the product./ The British and Indian police collaborated in catching the terrorist. Collide with (to collide)— It was predicted that a comet would collide with one of the planets. Combination of (combination)— The combination of Nitrogen and Glycerin creates a potent explosive. Combine with (to combine)— As a writer, he combined wit with passion. Commence on/with (to commence)— The course commences with a one week instruction on Art Theory. Commensurate with (commensurate)— He was paid a salary commensurate with skills and experience. Comment on/upon (to comment)—My mum always comments on/upon what I'm wearing. Commit to (to memorise)— Commit the passage to memory. Common to (common)—English has some features common to many languages. Communicate to/with/on (to convey to others)—We can now communicate instantly with people on the other side of the world./Has the news been communicated to the staff yet? Compare to (to compare between different things)— He compared the heart to a pump. Compare with (to compare between things of the same kind)— Compare Akbar with Aurangazeb. Compatible with (compatible)— Drive the car at a speed compatible with safety. Compensate for (to compensate)— He will compensate you for the loss. Compete with/for (to compete)—Both girls compete for their fathers' attention./I am not competing with that noise. Competent for (competent)— He is competent for the post. Comply with (to agree)— Mrs. Tania complied with my request. Composed of (composed)—The committee is composed of MPs, doctors, academics and members of the public. Conceal from (to conceal)—Is there anything you are concealing from me? Conceive of (to conceive)—He couldn't conceive of a time when he would have no job. Concentrate on/upon (to concentrate/to pay attention)—I am going to concentrate on/upon my writing for a while. Concern about/over/for sb/sth (concern)— Villagers expressed concern about the level of traffic. Concerned over/at/by sth, at/over sb/sth (worried)— Students are concerned for their result. Concerned in, with (involved, related)— I am not concerned in this matter. The lesson is concerned with poetry. Conclusion of/to/from (conclusion)— I found the conclusion of the film rather irritating./This is the conclusion to the story./You can draw some conclusion from the evidence. Condemn to (to condemn)— The criminal was condemned to death. Condole with/on (to condole)—We condoled with him on his loss. Conducive to (conducive)— Early rising is conducive to health. Confer on/with/about (to confer)— An honorary decorate was conferred on him by Edinburgh University./I shall confer with him about your prayer. Confidence in (confidence)— She has full confidence in her ability. Confident of (hopeful)— He is confident of success. Confined in/to (confined)— Let's confine our discussion to the matter in question please./He is confined in jail. Conform to (to follow)— A style of reporting must conform to the prevailing practice. Confront with (to confront)— Customers are confronted with a bewildering amount of choice. Confuse with (to confuse)—You're confusing me with my sister,— she's the one studying drama. Congenial to (congenial)— The climate is congenial to health. Congratulate on (to congratulate)— I congratulated him on his success. Connected or connection with (connected/connection)— Everyone tries to be connected with the film industry. Consist in (to consist in)— True happiness consists in contentment. Consist of (to consist of)— The school consists of five classrooms. Consistent with (consistent)— We do not consider his behaviour to be consistent with the holding of a high ranking job. Consolidate for (to consolidate)— The two companies consolidated for greater efficiency. Contact with (contact)—She finally made contact with him in Italy. Contemporary of (contemporary)— C. Marlowe was a contemporary of Shakespeare. Contented with (contented)— He is contented with a little. Contiguous to (contiguous)— The two states are contiguous with/to each other, but the laws are quite different. Convict of (to convict)— He has twice been convicted of robbery. Convinced of (convinced, assured)— He is convinced of your honesty. Cope with (to cope)— She cannot cope with so much work. Correspond with, about/to (to correspond, to be consistent)— I shall correspond with him about the matter./The American FBI corresponds to the British M15. Count upon/on (to depend)— I count on your help. Crave for (to crave)—He craves for wealth. Credit to an account/with money (to credit)— Credit the amount to my account./He credited my account with $ 20 after I pointed out the mistake. Creep up (to increase)— Prices are creeping up again. Cruise to (to win)— The home team cruised to victory. Culminate in (to reach the highest point)— The many years of research have finally culminated in a cure for the disease. Cure of/for (to treat/medicine)— At one time the doctors couldn't cure people of TB./There's still no cure for cancer. Curse for (to curse)— He cursed himself for his stupidity.

Engaged with/on/in, to (নিযুক্ত, বাগদত্তা)— I was engaged in conversation with him./He is engaged on books./My daughter is engaged to his son. explanation.mix: Intrude on/into/upon somebody/something অর্থ– কোনো কিছুতে জোর করে প্রবেশ করা বা অনধিকার প্রবেশ। বাক্যটির বাংলা: শত্রুর ক্যাম্পে অনধিকার প্রবেশ বিপজ্জনক। তাই সঠিক উত্তর (খ) ও (গ)। [Ref: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary.]
explanation.en: Intrude on/into/upon somebody/something means to enter something forcibly or to trespass. The Bangla of the sentence is: it is dangerous to intrude into the enemy's camp. So the correct answers are (b) and (c). [Ref: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary.]
explanation.bn: Intrude on/into/upon somebody/something অর্থ– কোনো কিছুতে জোর করে প্রবেশ করা বা অনধিকার প্রবেশ। বাক্যটির বাংলা: শত্রুর ক্যাম্পে অনধিকার প্রবেশ বিপজ্জনক। তাই সঠিক উত্তর (খ) ও (গ)। [Ref: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary.]

mcqs.source: Pubali Bank Ltd. Asst. Trainee Junior Officer (Cash) 2019

question.mix: It is not always easy to sympathise— an unfortunate man.
question.en: It is not always easy to sympathise — an unfortunate man.
question.bn: It is not always easy to sympathise — an unfortunate man.

explanation.mix: Sympathise with somebody অর্থ কারো প্রতি সহানুভূতিশীল হওয়া বা সমবেদনা প্রকাশ করা। With যোগে বাক্যের অর্থ: অভাগা ব্যক্তিকে সমবেদনা প্রদান করা সবসময় সহজ নয়।
explanation.en: Sympathise with somebody means to be sympathetic towards someone or to express condolence. With with, the meaning of the sentence is: it is not always easy to sympathise with an unfortunate man.
explanation.bn: Sympathise with somebody অর্থ কারো প্রতি সহানুভূতিশীল হওয়া বা সমবেদনা প্রকাশ করা। With যোগে বাক্যের অর্থ: অভাগা ব্যক্তিকে সমবেদনা প্রদান করা সবসময় সহজ নয়।

mcqs.source: Pubali Bank Ltd. Asst. Trainee Junior Officer (Cash) 2019

question.mix: We were at a disadvantage— that we did not have a very good knowledge of the language the others were using.
question.en: We were at a disadvantage — that we did not have a very good knowledge of the language the others were using.
question.bn: We were at a disadvantage — that we did not have a very good knowledge of the language the others were using.

explanation.mix: In that অর্থ for the reason that (কারণে)। শূন্যস্থানে in বসিয়ে বাক্যটির অর্থ: অন্যরা যেভাবে ভাষা জ্ঞান ব্যবহার করছিল সেরূপ আমাদের ভাষা জ্ঞান না থাকার কারণে আমরা প্রতিকূল পরিস্থিতির মধ্যে ছিলাম।
explanation.en: In that means for the reason that. Putting in in the blank, the meaning of the sentence is: we were at a disadvantage because we did not have a very good knowledge of the language the others were using.
explanation.bn: In that অর্থ for the reason that (কারণে)। শূন্যস্থানে in বসিয়ে বাক্যটির অর্থ: অন্যরা যেভাবে ভাষা জ্ঞান ব্যবহার করছিল সেরূপ আমাদের ভাষা জ্ঞান না থাকার কারণে আমরা প্রতিকূল পরিস্থিতির মধ্যে ছিলাম।

question.mix: Technology has developed — great speed.
question.en: Technology has developed — great speed.
question.bn: Technology has developed — great speed.

explanation.mix: At great speed অর্থ দ্রুত গতিতে। শূন্যস্থানে at বসিয়ে বাক্যটির বাংলা: প্রযুক্তি দ্রুতগতিতে উন্নত হয়েছে।
explanation.en: At great speed means at great speed. Putting at in the blank, the Bangla of the sentence is: technology has developed at great speed.
explanation.bn: At great speed অর্থ দ্রুত গতিতে। শূন্যস্থানে at বসিয়ে বাক্যটির বাংলা: প্রযুক্তি দ্রুতগতিতে উন্নত হয়েছে।

question.mix: Voting took place peacefully— most of the country.
question.en: Voting took place peacefully — most of the country.
question.bn: Voting took place peacefully — most of the country.

explanation.mix: Across most of the country অর্থ দেশের সর্বত্র। Across যোগে প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির অর্থ: দেশের সর্বত্র শান্তিপূর্ণভাবে ভোট গ্রহণ সম্পন্ন হলো।
explanation.en: Across most of the country means all over the country. With Across, the meaning of the given sentence is: voting took place peacefully across most of the country.
explanation.bn: Across most of the country অর্থ দেশের সর্বত্র। Across যোগে প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির অর্থ: দেশের সর্বত্র শান্তিপূর্ণভাবে ভোট গ্রহণ সম্পন্ন হলো।

question.mix: Use the right form of verb : I had no difficulty (to find) their house although they had said that people often did.
question.en: Use the right form of verb: I had no difficulty (to find) their house although they had said that people often did.
question.bn: Verb-এর সঠিক form ব্যবহার করো: I had no difficulty (to find) their house although they had said that people often did.

explanation.mix: Difficulty in + verb + ing হলো সঠিক ধারা। সুতরাং প্রদত্ত verb-এর সঠিক form in finding। In finding যোগে বাক্যটির বাংলা: তাদের বাড়ি খুঁজে পেতে আমার কোনো সমস্যা হয়নি যদিও তারা বলত যে লোকজন প্রায়ই সমস্যায় পড়ে।
explanation.en: Difficulty in + verb + ing is the correct pattern. So the correct form of the given verb is in finding. With In finding, the Bangla of the sentence is: I had no difficulty in finding their house although they had said that people often did.
explanation.bn: Difficulty in + verb + ing হলো সঠিক ধারা। সুতরাং প্রদত্ত verb-এর সঠিক form in finding। In finding যোগে বাক্যটির বাংলা: তাদের বাড়ি খুঁজে পেতে আমার কোনো সমস্যা হয়নি যদিও তারা বলত যে লোকজন প্রায়ই সমস্যায় পড়ে।

question.mix: Fill in the blank : Dogs have antipathy— cats.
question.en: Fill in the blank: Dogs have antipathy — cats.
question.bn: শূন্যস্থান পূরণ করো: Dogs have antipathy — cats.

explanation.mix: Antipathy to/toward somebody or something অর্থ কারো বা কোনো কিছুর প্রতি বিদ্বেষ। সুতরাং শূন্যস্থানে to বসবে।
explanation.en: Antipathy to/toward somebody or something means hatred towards someone or something. So to will sit in the blank.
explanation.bn: Antipathy to/toward somebody or something অর্থ কারো বা কোনো কিছুর প্রতি বিদ্বেষ। সুতরাং শূন্যস্থানে to বসবে।

question.mix: Fill in the blank with appropriate word : She availed herself— the opportunity.
question.en: Fill in the blank with the appropriate word: She availed herself — the opportunity.
question.bn: উপযুক্ত শব্দ দিয়ে শূন্যস্থান পূরণ করো: She availed herself — the opportunity.

explanation.mix: Avail oneself of অর্থ (সুযোগ) গ্রহণ করা; (সুযোগের) সদ্ব্যবহার করা। শূন্যস্থানে of বসিয়ে বাক্যটির বাংলা: সে সুযোগের সদ্ব্যবহার করল।
explanation.en: Avail oneself of means to take (an opportunity), to make good use of (an opportunity). Putting of in the blank, the Bangla of the sentence is: she availed herself of the opportunity.
explanation.bn: Avail oneself of অর্থ (সুযোগ) গ্রহণ করা; (সুযোগের) সদ্ব্যবহার করা। শূন্যস্থানে of বসিয়ে বাক্যটির বাংলা: সে সুযোগের সদ্ব্যবহার করল।

question.mix: He was killed— the robber— a hatchet.
question.en: He was killed — the robber — a hatchet.
question.bn: He was killed — the robber — a hatchet.

explanation.mix: Kill by somebody অর্থ কারো কর্তৃক হত্যা করা আর kill with something অর্থ কোনো কিছু দিয়ে হত্যা করা। সুতরাং শূন্যস্থানে by, with বসিয়ে বাক্যটির বাংলা: ডাকাত কর্তৃক তাকে কুঠার দিয়ে হত্যা করা হলো।
explanation.en: Kill by somebody means to be killed by someone, and kill with something means to be killed with something. So putting by, with in the blanks, the Bangla of the sentence is: he was killed by the robber with a hatchet.
explanation.bn: Kill by somebody অর্থ কারো কর্তৃক হত্যা করা আর kill with something অর্থ কোনো কিছু দিয়ে হত্যা করা। সুতরাং শূন্যস্থানে by, with বসিয়ে বাক্যটির বাংলা: ডাকাত কর্তৃক তাকে কুঠার দিয়ে হত্যা করা হলো।

question.mix: He has no good cause— complaint. Darkness was the cause— his losing his way.
question.en: He has no good cause — complaint. Darkness was the cause — his losing his way.
question.bn: He has no good cause — complaint. Darkness was the cause — his losing his way.

explanation.mix: Cause for something অর্থ কোনো কিছুর যুক্তি। সুতরাং for .... of বসবে আর বাক্যটির বাংলা: অভিযোগের কোনো সুযোগই ছিলো না। অন্ধকার ছিলো তার পথ হারানোর কারণ।
explanation.en: Cause for something means a reason for something. So for .... of will sit, and the Bangla of the sentence is: he had no good cause for complaint. Darkness was the cause of his losing his way.
explanation.bn: Cause for something অর্থ কোনো কিছুর যুক্তি। সুতরাং for .... of বসবে আর বাক্যটির বাংলা: অভিযোগের কোনো সুযোগই ছিলো না। অন্ধকার ছিলো তার পথ হারানোর কারণ।

question.mix: I don't care — your opinion.
question.en: I don't care — your opinion.
question.bn: I don't care — your opinion.

explanation.mix: Care about somebody/something অর্থাৎ কাউকে বা কোনো কিছু নিয়ে মাথাব্যথা/পরোয়া/ভয় থাকা। Preposition, about বসিয়ে বাক্যটির বাংলা তোমার মতামতকে আমি পরোয়া করি না।
explanation.en: Care about somebody/something means to care about someone or something. Putting the preposition about, the Bangla of the sentence is: I don't care about your opinion.
explanation.bn: Care about somebody/something অর্থাৎ কাউকে বা কোনো কিছু নিয়ে মাথাব্যথা/পরোয়া/ভয় থাকা। Preposition, about বসিয়ে বাক্যটির বাংলা তোমার মতামতকে আমি পরোয়া করি না।

question.mix: My best friend lives — the Chittaranjan Road
question.en: My best friend lives — the Chittaranjan Road
question.bn: My best friend lives — the Chittaranjan Road

explanation.mix: বাড়ি বা কোনো স্থাপনার (Building) অবস্থান নির্দেশ করতে রাস্তার নামের পূর্বে on preposition টি ব্যবহৃত হয়। সুনির্দিষ্ট ঠিকানা বোঝাতে at বসে। যেমন– at the 55 Chittaranjan Road। কিন্তু সুনির্দিষ্ট না হলে ঠিকানা লিখতে Road-এর নামের পূর্বে on বসে। যেমন– on the Chittaranjan Road।
explanation.en: To show the location of a house or a building, the preposition on is used before the name of a road. To show a specific address, at sits. For example — at the 55 Chittaranjan Road. But if it is not specific, on sits before the name of the road when writing the address. For example — on the Chittaranjan Road.
explanation.bn: বাড়ি বা কোনো স্থাপনার (Building) অবস্থান নির্দেশ করতে রাস্তার নামের পূর্বে on preposition টি ব্যবহৃত হয়। সুনির্দিষ্ট ঠিকানা বোঝাতে at বসে। যেমন– at the 55 Chittaranjan Road। কিন্তু সুনির্দিষ্ট না হলে ঠিকানা লিখতে Road-এর নামের পূর্বে on বসে। যেমন– on the Chittaranjan Road।

question.mix: I was alarmed — the news of my brother's illness.
question.en: I was alarmed — the news of my brother's illness.
question.bn: I was alarmed — the news of my brother's illness.

explanation.mix: Alarmed at something অর্থ আতঙ্কিত; পরিত্রস্ত। At যোগে বাক্যটির বাংলা আমি আমার ভাইয়ের অসুস্থতার সংবাদে আতঙ্কিত।
explanation.en: Alarmed at something means alarmed, frightened. With at, the Bangla of the sentence is: I was alarmed at the news of my brother's illness.
explanation.bn: Alarmed at something অর্থ আতঙ্কিত; পরিত্রস্ত। At যোগে বাক্যটির বাংলা আমি আমার ভাইয়ের অসুস্থতার সংবাদে আতঙ্কিত।

question.mix: They do not have enough capital to set themselves — — trade.
question.en: They do not have enough capital to set themselves — — trade.
question.bn: They do not have enough capital to set themselves — — trade.

explanation.mix: Set somebody up অর্থ প্রতিষ্ঠা করা আর in trade অর্থ ব্যবসাতে। Up, in যোগে বাক্যটির বাংলা: নিজেদের ব্যবসায় প্রতিষ্ঠা করার মতো যথেষ্ট মূলধন তাদের নেই।
explanation.en: Set somebody up means to establish, and in trade means in business. With Up, in, the Bangla of the sentence is: they do not have enough capital to set themselves up in trade.
explanation.bn: Set somebody up অর্থ প্রতিষ্ঠা করা আর in trade অর্থ ব্যবসাতে। Up, in যোগে বাক্যটির বাংলা: নিজেদের ব্যবসায় প্রতিষ্ঠা করার মতো যথেষ্ট মূলধন তাদের নেই।

question.mix: A gentleman should be true— his words.
question.en: A gentleman should be true — his words.
question.bn: A gentleman should be true — his words.

explanation.en: Be true to one's word means to keep one's word or promise. So to will sit in the blank.
explanation.bn: Be true to one's word অর্থ কথা/প্রতিশ্রুতি রাখা। তাই শূন্যস্থানে to বসবে।

question.mix: He succeeded by dint— his hard labour.
question.en: He succeeded by dint — his hard labour.
question.bn: He succeeded by dint — his hard labour.

explanation.mix: 'By dint of' phrase-টির বাংলা অর্থ সাহায্যে, দ্বারা। শূন্য স্থানে of যোগে বাক্যটির বাংলা: তার কঠোর পরিশ্রমের সাহায্যে সে সফলতা লাভ করল।
explanation.en: The Bangla meaning of the phrase 'By dint of' is by means of, by. With of in the blank, the Bangla of the sentence is: he succeeded by dint of his hard labour.
explanation.bn: 'By dint of' phrase-টির বাংলা অর্থ সাহায্যে, দ্বারা। শূন্য স্থানে of যোগে বাক্যটির বাংলা: তার কঠোর পরিশ্রমের সাহায্যে সে সফলতা লাভ করল।

question.mix: The view — the open window is very pretty.
question.en: The view — the open window is very pretty.
question.bn: The view — the open window is very pretty.

explanation.en: Through + something — through something. The view through the open window is very pretty.
explanation.bn: Through + sth— কোনো কিছুর ভিতর দিয়ে। The view through the open window is very pretty.

question.en: He is walking — a corner store.

explanation.mix: শূন্যস্থানে in বসবে। In বসিয়ে বাংলা হবে: সে corner store-এ হাঁটাহাঁটি করছে। কোনো স্থানের মাঝে বোঝাতে পূর্বে in বসে। তাছাড়া walk into অর্থ খুশি হয়ে যাওয়া; ইচ্ছা করে কোনোকিছুর সম্মুখীন হওয়া। Walk for বলে কোনো phrasal verb নেই আর walk over অর্থ অনায়াসে হারানো।
explanation.en: In will sit in the blank. With in, the Bangla will be: he is walking in a corner store. To show being inside a place, in sits before it. Besides, walk into means to go in happily, to face something willingly. There is no phrasal verb called Walk for, and walk over means to defeat easily.
explanation.bn: শূন্যস্থানে in বসবে। In বসিয়ে বাংলা হবে: সে corner store-এ হাঁটাহাঁটি করছে। কোনো স্থানের মাঝে বোঝাতে পূর্বে in বসে। তাছাড়া walk into অর্থ খুশি হয়ে যাওয়া; ইচ্ছা করে কোনোকিছুর সম্মুখীন হওয়া। Walk for বলে কোনো phrasal verb নেই আর walk over অর্থ অনায়াসে হারানো।
